content:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a p99 jump on prefill-heavy traces after yesterday's microbatching heuristic tweak. p99 went from ~260ms -> ~510ms for short requests. logs attached.


derek: Any KV cache misses? :thinking:


maya: Yes. profiler shows KV cache eviction spikes right when microbatch size grows beyond 6. KV miss rate from ~2% -> ~18% during spikes.


sophie: Can you paste the perf counters / GPU timeline / scheduler stacks?


maya: pasted below: 
```
# sample trace (aggregate 1m)
prefill_avg: 42ms
prefill_p95: 210ms
prefill_p99: 480ms
decode_avg: 28ms
decode_p95: 90ms
decode_p99: 130ms
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.02 -> 0.18
microbatch_size_dist: mode=8, 90p=12
kernel_switches: 3->9 (increased fallback to generic matmul)
```


aj: Looks like kernel selection is thrashing — when seq len is small but microbatch grows, our heuristics flip kernels which allocate larger KV buffers causing node-level evictions.


derek: Timeline: heuristic change rolled at 03:10 UTC (commit sha abc123). We'll rollback the selector in canary to verify.


maya: Also seeing node-level tail spikes coincide with KV warmup after splitpoint. Attaching scheduler logs (stack traces show repeated alloc/free of KV buffers).


sophie: Quick experiment idea: cap microbatch max for session-prefill to 6 for 1 hour and measure p99. That should reduce KV working set and avoid kernel thrash.


runtime-oncall: Created experiment job exp/kv-cap-6 at 1728412400; routing 5% of traffic.


ci-bot: Deploy of exp/kv-cap-6 succeeded on canaries :white_check_mark:


aj: Also propose tuning kernel heuristic to bias low-allocation kernel when estimated KV footprint is high OR seq_len < 64. That should reduce unnecessary kernel switches.


derek: Can you sketch the change? small patch ok for today if low-risk.


aj: sketch: 
```
if (seq_len < 64 && est_kv_bytes > 8MB) {
  select_kernel(low_alloc_kernel);
} else {
  select_kernel(high_throughput_kernel);
}
```


maya: If we do both (cap microbatch + kernel tweak) we might see p99 back to ~220-240ms. Running local perf now.


sophie: Also add console metrics: kv_evictions_per_min and kernel_switch_rate. Alert if kv_evictions_per_min > 10/min so we catch recurrence quickly.


derek: Agree. I'll add a derived metric and a short-term alert (24h) while we validate.


maya: Early canary results (first 10m): p99 down to 230ms, kv_miss_rate -> 4%. Signal looks promising.


aj: Nice. Plan: rollback selector on all canaries, keep microbatch cap for 1 hour, and land kernel heuristic tweak behind flag. Gradual rollout if stable.


runtime-oncall: Rolling exp to 25% at 1728412480.


maya: Thanks. Will monitor tail metrics (p99/p999/p50) and upload traces to perf-dashboard. Follow-up: add unit test around heuristic boundary and a small end-to-end perf harness.


sophie: Noted — I'll own the unit test and dashboard panels.


derek: Thanks team. Tagging this for a short postmortem and a changelog entry.


maya: :thumbsup:
